how to upload to the domain this website
Today

For this site it's a single file, so it's super quick. You don't need to rebuild anything — just upload Index.html.

Easiest way (free, 2 minutes):

  1. Go to Netlify Drop or Vercel
  2. Rename the file to index.html (lowercase)
  3. Drag it onto the page — you get a live link like klipup.netlify.app
  4. Then connect your domain: in Netlify → Site Settings → Domain Management → Add your domain (e.g. klipup.ai)

If you already have a domain + hosting (like Hostinger, GoDaddy, Bluehost):

  1. Login to your hosting cPanel / file manager
  2. Open public_html / www folder
  3. Upload Index.html there and rename it to index.html
  4. That's it — your domain will now show the site

If you use Cloudflare / GitHub:

  • GitHub Pages: Create a repo, upload index.html, go to Settings → Pages → Deploy, then in your domain DNS add the CNAME GitHub gives you
  • Cloudflare Pages: Same drag-and-drop as Netlify, then add your custom domain

Important for this file:

  • It's all-in-one — images, CSS and JS are embedded inside Index.html, so you only upload that one file. Nothing else is needed.
  • If you want to change the domain to point here, set the DNS A record / CNAME to whatever your host gives you. Don't set it to this preview link.

Want me to tell you exactly for your case? Tell me:

  1. Where did you buy the domain from (GoDaddy, Hostinger, Namecheap, Cloudflare)?
  2. Do you already have hosting?

I'll give you the exact steps for that one.

404 File not found The site configured at this address does not contain the requested file. If this is your site, make sure that the filename case matches the URL as well as any file permissions. For root URLs (like http://example.com/) you must provide an index.html file. Read the full documentation for more information about using GitHub Pages. GitHub Status — @githubstatus
Today

Yes — that's a GitHub Pages 404, and it's exactly the filename issue.

Fix it in 30 seconds:

Your file is currently named Index.html with a capital I. GitHub Pages is case-sensitive and for the root URL it must be lowercase index.html.

Do this:

  1. Go to your GitHub repo → click on Index.html
  2. Click the pencil ✏️ to edit / or click ... → Rename
  3. Rename it to exactly: index.html (all lowercase)
  4. Commit it
  5. Wait 30 sec and refresh your domain — the 404 will be gone

Also check these two things:

  • The file must be at the root of the repo, not inside a folder like /site/ or /docs/ — if it's inside a folder, move it to the root
  • In GitHub → Settings → Pages, make sure it's set to:
    • Branch: main
    • Folder: / (root)

If you already renamed it and still see 404, wait 1-2 minutes — GitHub Pages takes a minute to redeploy. Or hard refresh Ctrl + Shift + R.

If you want, tell me your repo link and I'll check what's wrong in the repo.

when they fill details in discovery what happens
Today
Show thinking

When they fill the Discovery form, this is what happens — in 3 steps:

Step 1 — Form (1 of 3):
They enter: First name, Last name, Email, Company, Industry, Company size, Package, Budget, Current Challenge, How soon to start, How they heard about you.

On submit, the site does a POST with all that data as JSON to your webhook:
https://script.google.com/macros/s/AKfycbzP.../exec — that's a Google Apps Script. That script is what saves it to your Google Sheet / emails you.

If it succeeds:

"Thanks. Your discovery details were sent successfully. Continue to Step 2 to book on Calendly."[Name]

If it fails (webhook down):

"Your discovery details are ready for scheduling. The discovery service could not be reached, but you can still continue to Step 2 to book on Calendly."
— It still lets them continue, it doesn't block them.

Step 2 — Discovery Scheduling (2 of 3):
It moves them to the Calendly embed:
calendly.com/founders-klipup/30min
They book the 30-min call there.

Step 3 — Payment (3 of 3):
Then it shows the Stripe payment link for the package they chose:

  • Product Team: $3k/mo
  • Growth Team: $3k/mo
  • Startup Team: $8k/mo

So: Form → Google Sheet / email to you → Calendly booking → Stripe payment.

Want me to show you what the Google Script does with that data, or add an email confirmation to the person who fills it?

1. Netlify Drop (easiest + free)

  • Go to app.netlify.com/drop
  • Drag index.html (rename to lowercase index.html)
  • Free live link in 30 seconds, then add your own domain free

2. Vercel (free)

  • vercel.com → New Project → drag the file
  • Free, very fast

3. GitHub Pages (free — the one you're using now)

4. Cloudflare Pages (free)

  • pages.cloudflare.com → Upload index.html
  • Free + you can connect your domain for free there too

All 4 are 100% free for a single-file site like yours — no card needed.
